During the period 1989-94, which type of car featured a continuous decrease in production?
solution:
Given:

The table shows the production of five types of cars P, Q, R, S and T by a company from the year 1989 to 1994.

Concept used:

When the value of data keeps on decreasing with the order of the observations, the data is said to be decreasing successively. 

Calculation:

From the table is observed that only the production of R type of car decreased successive every year between 1989-1994.

∴ The car which has a successive decrease over the given years is 'R'
